note: Recorded-shape fixture for the Session AP service-row replay (scripts/run11/service-rows). Shapes follow the parsers that read them; values are illustrative, not a live capture. Times are relative to recordedAt and are re-based by the harness.
endpoint: GET https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/coins/{id}/market_chart?vs_currency=usd&days=1|7|30|90|365&precision=full → {prices:[[ms,price],…]} (market_caps and total_volumes are discarded by lib/market-history.ts and left out). The provider answers hourly points up to 90 days and daily beyond; the stub serves the last `days` of `hourly` when recorded, else of `daily`. USD only.
